'''Oleksiy Ivanovych Pecherov''' ({{langx|uk|Олексій Іванович Печеров}}; born 8 December 1985) is a Ukrainian former professional [[basketball]] player. He was also a member of the [[Ukraine national basketball team]].

==Professional career==
The [[Washington Wizards]] selected him with the 18th pick in the [[2006 NBA draft]]; Pecherov signed a contract with the Wizards on 5 July 2007. Pecherov had previously played with [[Paris Basket Racing]] internationally.

On 23 June 2009 he was traded along with [[Etan Thomas]], [[Darius Songaila]], and a first-round pick to the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] for [[Randy Foye]] and [[Mike Miller (basketball, born 1980)|Mike Miller]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Wizards Acquire Miller and Foye From Minnesota|url=http://www.nba.com/wizards/news/millerfoye_090624.html|access-date=May 6, 2014|newspaper=NBA.com|date=June 23, 2009}}</ref>

On 16 August 2010 he signed with [[Olimpia Milano]] of the [[Serie A (basketball)|Italian league]] and the [[Euroleague]] for the 2010–11 season.<ref>{{cite news |date=August 16, 2010 |title=AJ MILANO tabs Pecherov |url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/74874/aj-milano-nabs-pecherov |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150402141454/http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/74874/aj-milano-nabs-pecherov |archive-date=2015-04-02 |access-date=May 6, 2014 |newspaper=Euroleague.net}}</ref> On 23 August 2011 he signed a two-year deal with [[BC Azovmash]] of Ukraine.<ref>{{cite news|title=Azovmash inks Pecherov for two years|url=http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/87258/3735|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120930231144/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/87258/3735|url-status=dead|archive-date=September 30, 2012|access-date=May 6, 2014|newspaper=Eurocupbasketball.com|date=August 23, 2011}}</ref>

On 9 November 2013 he signed a one-month deal with [[Valencia BC]] of the Spanish [[ACB League]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Valencia signs Oleksiy Pecherov to a short-term deal|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/cat/nba/107932/valencia-signs-oleksiy-pecherov-to-a-short-term-deal.html|access-date=May 6, 2014|newspaper=Sportando.com|date=November 9, 2013}}</ref>

On 22 January 2014 he signed with [[BC Krasnye Krylia|Krasnye Krylia]] of Russia for the rest of the 2013–14 season.<ref>{{cite news|title=Oleskiy Pecherov signs with Krasnye Krylya Samara|url=http://www.sportando.com/eng/europe/russia/72253/oleskiy-pecherov-signs-with-krasnye-krylya-samara.html|access-date=February 6, 2014|newspaper=Sportando.com|date= January 22, 2014}}</ref> He left them on 6 May 2014.<ref>{{cite news|title=Oleksij Pecherov leaves Krasnye Krylia Samara|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/119098/oleksij-pecherov-leaves-krasnye-krylia-samara.html|access-date=May 6, 2014|newspaper=Sportando.com|date=May 6, 2014}}</ref>

On 4 February 2015 he signed with [[BC Kalev/Cramo|Kalev/Cramo]] of the [[Korvpalli Meistriliiga]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Oleksiy Pecherov joins BC Kalev/Cramo|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/estonia/151150/oleksiy-pecherov-joins-bc-kalevcramo.html|access-date=February 4, 2015|newspaper=Sportando.com|date= February 4, 2015}}</ref>

On 28 September 2015 Pecherov signed with the [[Denver Nuggets]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/nuggets/gallery/2015-training-camp-introductions|title=2015 Training Camp Introductions|work=NBA.com|date=September 28, 2015|access-date=October 1, 2015}}</ref> However, he was later waived by the Nuggets on October 24 after appearing in one preseason game.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=18518|title=Nuggets waive Nick Johnson, Oleksiy Pecherov, Devin Sweetney|work=InsideHoops.com|date=October 24, 2015|access-date=October 24, 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160113060306/http://www.insidehoops.com/blog/?p=18518|archive-date=January 13, 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On 3 February 2016 he signed with [[Hekmeh BC|Hekmeh]] of the [[Lebanese Basketball League]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Oleksiy Pecherov signs a deal in Lebanon with Sagesse|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/asia/189919/oleksiy-pecherov-signs-a-deal-in-lebanon-with-sagesse.html|access-date=February 3, 2016|work=Sportando.com|date=February 3, 2016}}</ref>
